                                               FOREWORD
This book a focused resource designed exclusively for practice, helping you sharpen and perfect your Logical
Reasoning skills. This book is a natural extension of the Essentials and Empower series, aimed at providing you
with ample opportunities to apply your understanding of Critical Reasoning (CR) concepts.

Unlike its predecessors, this book is purely practice-oriented, featuring a diverse range of assignments tailored to
the latest exam patterns. These assignments are structured to challenge your grasp of Logical Reasoning, enabling
you to reinforce your strengths and identify areas for improvement.

Use these assignments as a tool to refine your problem-solving strategies and enhance your speed and accuracy.
With consistent effort and rigorous practice, we are confident that this book will play a crucial role in your
preparation journey.

Wishing you success in achieving your academic aspirations.


Happy Learning!
